$Comment: Martha's Regular: the title the achievement harvest_feast_set_of_plates pays, for sitting down to The Feast with Martha over several years. It shows beside a player's name in menus and leaderboards once they pick it. It names no keys: title.harvest_feast_marthas_regular.name and .flavor name and describe it, and .display, whose {0} is the name, is where it sits around the name. Enabled false hides it everywhere without taking it from anybody who earned it.
